title: SafeToolBench: Pioneering a Prospective Benchmark to Evaluating Tool Utilization Safety in LLMs

bias_targets.target: General Bias and Offensiveness (Race, Gender, Sexual Orientation)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM agents using a prospective tool utilization benchmark (SafeToolBench) containing adversarial user instructions. The benchmark tests if the agent will execute or refuse tool planning calls (APIs) that generate, download, or disseminate discriminatory, prejudiced, or offensive content. The agent's safety awareness is measured by its ability to identify these risks from three perspectives: the user instruction, the tool itself, and the joint instruction-tool interaction.
